name: Automation & Addons
description: Full automation rules engine and addon system with password-protected sharing
author: Sheetflow

name: Export CSV
description: Export visible rows as CSV. Hidden rows are excluded.
author: Sheetflow

name: Find & Replace
description: Search and replace text across all cells in the spreadsheet.
author: Sheetflow

name: Hide & Restore
description: Hide individual rows, restore hidden rows, hide zero-value rows, or restore all.
author: Sheetflow

name: Row Filter Builder
description: Build complex multi-condition filters to show or hide rows based on any combination of rules.
author: Sheetflow

name: SDK Showcase
description: Interactive demo of everything the Sheetflow SDK can do. Adds buttons, dropdowns, sidebar panels, modals, keyboard shortcuts, and data hooks.
author: Sheetflow

name: Search & Filter
description: Search rows by text, filter by scope, sort by column.
author: Sheetflow

name: Sheet Editor
description: Click any cell to edit its value directly. Tab moves to the next cell.
author: Sheetflow

name: Sort & Group
description: View rows grouped by any field. Sort by name, value, or original order.
author: Sheetflow

name: Summary
description: Shows a collapsible summary of visible rows, hidden rows, groups, and value totals.
author: Sheetflow
